monitor_hint: 每个应用占整台服务器的比例，每隔几秒刷新一次。选择应用可查看各容器的明细。
unlisted_store: 此应用来自您未添加的商店：
unlisted_store_hint: 请仅在信任该来源时安装。
restore_from_backup_hint: 在该备份的数据和 .env 之上重新安装应用。
domains_hint: 应用可响应的额外名称，添加在主域名之上，而非取而代之。每个名称都会成为每个应用上的一条 Caddy 标签，因此各自携带自己的路由指令。保存会重写这些标签并重启所有正在运行的应用。
main_domain_hint: 由本服务器在 .env.app 中设置，并由每个应用自己的 compose 文件路由。{app} 从不修改它——下方的域名是在其之外额外添加的。
extra_domains_hint: 每个条目都会在应用已有路由之外，为每个应用再添加一条路由。主机名是模板，在应用启动时解析，因此本服务器地址变化时它会自动跟随。可用变量：
domains_empty: 暂无额外域名。应用仅在主域名上响应。
directives_hint: 应用于为该主机生成的路由。TLS 属于域名而非应用：由本服务器证书提供服务的主机使用 import = gateway_tls；需要通过 Let's Encrypt 自行签发证书的主机则留空。
domains_apply_hint: 尚未应用——保存会重写每个应用的 Caddy 标签并重启正在运行的应用。
domains_applied: 已保存。正在运行的应用将以新标签重启。
domains_duplicate: 两个条目使用了相同的主机名。
app_env_hint: {app} 传递给所安装的每个应用的变量 —— 域名、网络，以及应用初始化时使用的身份信息。文件中的注释对每一项都有说明。空值表示“未设置”：该键会被跳过，而不是以空值传递。
app_env_applies: 保存后的修改会在每个应用下次启动时生效。此处不会重启任何应用。
app_env_ignored: 以下变量由 {app} 按应用自行设置 —— 在此处填写的值不会生效：
backups_hint: Where your backups go, how often they are made, and every backup you have. One is also made whenever you back an app up by hand and whenever you uninstall one — uninstalling never deletes data, it archives it.
backup_state_manual_only: Backups are only made when you ask for one. Nothing is scheduled.
backup_state_none: This server has no backups yet.
backup_state_engine_broken: Backups are set to go somewhere this server cannot reach, so the next one will fail.
backup_run_hint: One run backs up every app, one at a time — each is stopped for as long as its copy takes. There is one schedule for the whole server, whichever engine the backups go to.
backup_autosaved: Changes here are saved as you make them.
backup_receives_nothing: Nothing is written here. What it already holds stays listed and restorable.
backup_row_failing: the last backup to it failed
backup_row_nothing_yet: nothing has been written to it yet
backup_row_manual_only: only when you ask — nothing is scheduled
backup_row_history_only: keeping older backups; nothing new is written here
backup_state_no_destination: Nothing is being backed up: no destination is set to receive anything.
backup_state_destination_failing: One of your backup destinations is not working.
backup_receives_schedule_label: Back up here on the nightly run
backup_receives_rollback_fact: Update rollback points are always kept here, whatever these say — undoing an update has to be instant, and only this server's own disk can be.
backup_survives_yes: Yes — backups are sent off this server.
backup_survives_no: No — backups sit on the same disk as your apps.
backup_encrypted_no_key: Encrypted — but this server has no repository set up yet, so there is no key.
backup_encrypted_no: None — these archives are plain folders on this server's disk.
backup_retention_by_engine: The repository applies this itself, so it keeps working even if Maison is reinstalled.
backup_retention_by_maison: Maison applies this after each backup. These archives are full copies of an app folder, so they are counted rather than thinned into daily, weekly and monthly tiers.
backup_retention_from_default: Following the built-in default. Change it here to decide for this engine.
backup_retention_from_provisioned: Chosen by whoever set this server up. Change it here to decide for this engine.
backup_retention_from_box: Inherited from this server's own setting. Change it here to decide for this engine alone.
backup_mode_smart: Daily for a week, then weekly, then monthly
backup_key_absent: This server has no encryption key yet — its repository has not been set up.
user_data_hint: {source} 中除应用自身数据（每个应用单独备份）以外的所有内容——文档、下载、媒体，以及你存放在那里的一切。
user_data_empty: 尚无你的文件的备份。下次计划运行时会创建一个。
user_data_interrupted: 一次文件恢复被中断且未完成。你的文件目前是备份内容与原有内容的混合。请再次恢复以完成。
user_data_interrupted_stamp: 当时正在恢复 {when} 的备份。
user_data_mode_copy_hint: 把文件放到 {dest}，不改动你现有的内容。适合找回少量文件。
user_data_mode_in_place: 用此备份替换我的文件
user_data_mode_in_place_hint: 把你的文件恢复到当时的状态。
user_data_in_place_warning: 自该备份以来新增或修改的文件将被删除。你的应用及其数据不受影响。此操作无法从本页撤销——但系统会先备份你当前的文件，可通过恢复该备份回退。
user_data_excluded: 未包含在备份中，因此不会恢复：{list}
user_data_in_place_ack: 我明白我当前的文件将被替换
backups_orphan_hint: 该应用未安装。恢复备份会连同磁贴一起恢复。
backup_hint: 备份会归档该应用的整个文件夹：compose 文件、.env 和数据。应用会短暂停止以保证副本一致，随后重新启动。
backup_space: 约需复制 {size}，需要 {needed} · 剩余 {free}
backup_excluded: 应用已将其排除在备份之外：{list}（{size}）。
backup_excluded_bad: Maison 无法应用该应用的部分排除规则，因此这些路径仍会被备份：{list}
backup_restore_excluded: 不在此备份中，因此不会恢复 — 应用会重建它们：{list}
backup_restore_confirm: 用该备份替换此应用？当前状态会先被归档。
backup_delete_confirm: 删除该备份？此操作无法撤销。
backup_engine_unconfigured: The selected engine has no repository configured, so scheduled backups will fail.
backup_run_progress: 正在备份 — 第 {done}/{total} 项
backup_key_hint: Your backups are encrypted with a key held only on this server. Save a copy somewhere safe — show it here and store it yourself, or have it emailed to you. Without it, backups cannot be restored, and nobody can recover it for you.
backup_key_sent_on: A copy was emailed to {to} on {when}.
backup_key_never_sent: No copy of this key has been emailed yet.
resources_hint: 这台设备此刻在做什么，以及它一直在做什么。
resources_summed_note: 历史记录每分钟只保存一个汇总值，因此按网卡、按设备的明细仅在实时视图中可见。
resources_host_proc_missing: 未挂载宿主机的 /proc，{app} 在这里只能看到自己的容器。请为此部署添加 /host/proc 挂载，以查看宿主机的网卡与进程。
resources_unmeasured: 另有 {count} 个宿主机文件系统未挂载到此处，无法测量。
resources_speed_test_hint: 通过 Cloudflare 双向各传输 25 MB，测试期间会占用带宽。
resources_disk_bench_hint: 在数据盘写入并回读 256 MB，会短暂占满磁盘 IO，请避免在繁忙时运行。
resources_bench_cached: 缓存读取（该文件系统不支持直接 IO）
resources_recording_hint: 历史记录是无人查看仪表盘时 {app} 唯一会做的测量：每分钟一次，写入固定大小的文件。关闭后将不再采样或存储。
app_stores_hint: {app} 可安装应用的来源。每个商店是一个存放应用目录的地址；添加后会在应用商店中单独成组显示。
store_last_source: 无法移除最后一个商店 — 否则将没有可安装的应用。
store_refresh_hint: 每次服务器启动时都会重新读取所有商店，之后每晚 03:00 再次读取。点击 ⟳ 可立即获取某个商店。
notifications_hint: 此服务器当前存在的问题，以及你将如何收到通知。问题出现时通知一次，恢复时再通知一次——不会重复打扰。
notifications_all_clear: 一切正常。此服务器监控的项目都在正常运行。
notifications_mail_hint: 无论是否配置邮件，警报都会显示在此页面和顶部铃铛中。邮件的作用是在你没有查看面板时通知你。
notifications_mail_unconfigured: 尚未配置邮件服务器，因此不会发送邮件。警报仍会记录在此处。
notifications_smtp_inherit_hint: 留空则沿用此服务器初始配置的值。更换邮件服务器时用户名和密码会随之更换，请一并填写。
notifications_test_sent: 已发送。如果没有收到，请检查上述地址的垃圾邮件文件夹。
notifications_mute_hint: 取消勾选后将不再发送该类邮件。问题仍会被记录并显示在此页面。
incident_app.stackup: {app} 的某个初始化步骤失败
